Here is a list of items you can purchase with Commemorative Siege Guild Coins.

= Blood of Frost Giant =
New medicine developed by the joint effort of Alchemy Union of 3 countries. Gives the user supernatural powers for a short period of time.
^4d4dffDrains 3000 HP, but increases physical and magical damage to the user's counterpart players by 100% for 10 seconds.
Required Level: 80 or higher^000000

= Core of Golem =
New medicine developed by the joint effort of Alchemy Union of 3 countries. Gives the user supernatural powers for a short period of time.
^4d4dffDrains 300 SP, but decreases the damage taken from the user's counterpart players by 50% for 10 seconds.
Required Level: 80 or higher^000000

= Fairy's Tear (Stun) =
A potion developed by Vicent, a pharmaceutical genius. Gives the user supernatural powers for a short period of time.
^4d4dffDrains 3000 HP, but allows the user to become immune to Stun status for 10 seconds.^000000

= Fairy's Tear (Petrify) =
A potion developed by Vicent, a pharmaceutical genius. Gives the user supernatural powers for a short period of time.
^4d4dffDrains 3000 HP, but allows the user to become immune to Petrification status for 10 seconds.^000000

= Fairy's Tear (Frozen) =
A potion developed by Vicent, a pharmaceutical genius. Gives the user supernatural powers for a short period of time.
^4d4dffDrains 3000 HP, but allows the user to become immune to Frozen status for 10 seconds.^000000

= Fairy's Tear (Sleep) =
A potion developed by Vicent, a pharmaceutical genius. Gives the user supernatural powers for a short period of time.
^4d4dffDrains 3000 HP, but allows the user to become immune to Sleep status for 10 seconds.^000000

= Fairy's Tear (Curse) =
A potion developed by Vicent, a pharmaceutical genius. Gives the user supernatural powers for a short period of time.
^4d4dffDrains 3000 HP, but allows the user to become immune to Curse status for 10 seconds.^000000

= Fairy's Tear (Silence) =
A potion developed by Vicent, a pharmaceutical genius. Gives the user supernatural powers for a short period of time.
^4d4dffDrains 3000 HP, but allows the user to become immune to Silence status for 10 seconds.^000000

= Fairy's Tear (Blind) =
A potion developed by Vicent, a pharmaceutical genius. Gives the user supernatural powers for a short period of time.
^4d4dffDrains 3000 HP, but allows the user to become immune to Blind status for 10 seconds.^000000

= Feather Beret[1] =
A comfortable, sky blue-colored hat decorated with feathers.
^4d4dffMDEF + 1, Decreases the damage taken from the user's counterpart players by 10%.
Card Slot [1], available to all job classes except for Novices.

= Feather Beret Costume =
A comfortable, sky blue-colored hat decorated with feathers.
^4d4dffCostume Equipment, available to all job classes.^000000
This is the end of the list.
